setup_notes: Run python3 setup.py; SHA256-locked offline archives supply Lean, native upstream sources and imported dependency artifacts.
All new models use native DeFiFormal Word 64 checked arithmetic. Imported dependencies remain cached. New benchmark proof helpers are recompiled inside each assisted replay.
Human adaptation zero; AI work is assisted and effort is recorded separately in onboarding. P3-N4/N16 share one adaptation allowance.
Dependency closure build is unavailable; benchmark clean build is timed separately. No dependency timing is inferred from cache setup.
Source attribution uses reviewed Lean lexical code lines plus native Lean parser inventory and Python ast/tokenize. Infrastructure/admission sources are excluded.

numeric_representation.stored: Native Word 64 contains exactly natural values below 2^64; accounts are Fin 3. Canonical domain/validity retain all symbolic amounts and accounts.
numeric_representation.intermediates: Recipient bounds, x+d bounds, totals and comparison products are mathematical Nat. Native mulDiv computes the full Nat product before divideNat floor and checked output conversion.
numeric_representation.widening: Ledger total <=3*M<2^66. Swap product <=M^2<2^128. No 64-bit wrapping or checked mul narrowing occurs.

correspondence_notes.identity: New canonical INT64 ledger/AMM models adapted to pinned DeFiFormal DefiKernel.Arithmetic.Word 64, checked Operations.add/sub, and Rounding.mulDiv .down. Lean/mathlib verifies these explicit adapted-library workloads. No proof about an upstream protocol, compiler or deployed bytecode is claimed.

domain.stored: Native Word 64 contains exactly natural values below 2^64; accounts are Fin 3. Canonical domain/validity retain all symbolic amounts and accounts.
domain.intermediates: Recipient bounds, x+d bounds, totals and comparison products are mathematical Nat. Native mulDiv computes the full Nat product before divideNat floor and checked output conversion.
domain.widening: Ledger total <=3*M<2^66. Swap product <=M^2<2^128. No 64-bit wrapping or checked mul narrowing occurs.

claims.P1: Model.P1: valid implies mathematical total equality AND every nonparticipant unchanged. Fin account identifiers cover all six distinct sender/recipient pairs.
claims.P2: Model.P2: computed native Rounding.mulDiv .down quote; widened reserve-product inequality under swapDomain. NativeHelper and assisted target derive successful checked operations, exact floor semantics and strict q<y; no output or preservation premise.
claims.P3-N4: Model.P3 4: arbitrary independent instruction list of length 4; traceValid recomputes validity in every actual preceding state.
claims.P3-N16: Same definitions and procedure with length 16; no repeated-amount restriction.

correspondence_notes.partial_operation: valueOrZero totalizes a native arithmetic error to zero solely outside the specified partial domain. Assisted correspondence derives .ok for every native operation on valid inputs. Negative Nat values, oversized Word values and accounts outside Fin 3 are unrepresentable; Examples proves representation completeness and exclusions. No invalid transition behavior is claimed.
correspondence_notes.assistance: All canonical target proofs and NativeHelper/TransferHelper/SequenceHelper are AI-authored assistance. The frozen omega macro has no target guidance. New proof helpers are compiled during every assisted replay and counted once by shared-helper inventory. P3 instantiates a general symbolic-list theorem at exact lengths 4 and 16.
correspondence_notes.sequence: General list theorem, arbitrary independent instruction objects, validity at each actual intermediate native-arithmetic state. Generic induction is recorded explicitly; length scaling is instantiation rather than unrolling.
correspondence_notes.proof_boundary: Lean elaboration/tactic execution and kernel checking plus exact named axiom whitelist. Independent leanchecker kernel replays every newly authored model/procedure/helper/target module from existing olean artifacts; pinned imported libraries remain trusted, not --fresh. This checker uses the same Lean kernel and is not an independent implementation.
correspondence_notes.identity_limits: The ledger and no-fee reserve swap are new benchmark model composition. Native arithmetic operations are reused; unrelated upstream DeFi protocol theorems are not claimed as the measured workloads.
correspondence_notes.reconstruction: Offline SHA256-locked official Lean archive and pinned upstream source/dependency cache. Fresh adapter, HOME, cache and extracted runtime. Host OS shared; not an OS/security sandbox. No network needed.
correspondence_notes.builds: Benchmark clean build recompiles every new model/helper/assisted target module with pinned imported dependencies retained. Full imported dependency closure rebuild is unavailable in this adapter; prebuilt artifacts are explicit setup context.
correspondence_notes.artifacts: Distinct Lean compiled .olean module parts include proof terms; sizes/hashes retained by harness. They are not tool logs or a portable standalone proof certificate.
correspondence_notes.source_accounting: Reviewed Lean lexical code lines and Python ast/tokenize; native Lean command-parser supplemental inventory contains recovery errors explicitly. Generated files match retained templates. Infrastructure/admission checks and the unrelated selection example are excluded from benchmark counts. Mixed declaration/proof lines take specification as primary role; generated automatic files include the frozen tactic invocation with specification role.

machine.parallelism: Lean -j1; checker one target at a time with LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1; local measurements serial

proof_method.verification: Lean source elaboration/tactics and kernel checking; exact established axiom whitelist
proof_method.checker: Bundled Lean 4.33.0-rc2 leanchecker checks every new module without source tactic execution. Same kernel implementation; pinned imported dependency artifacts trusted; --fresh not used.

assumptions: Only canonical validity/range premises in Model.lean.
Standard Lean axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound permitted. No sorryAx/custom axioms.
abstractions: Three-account abstract ledger, explicit independent instruction list and no-fee constant-product swap. No contract/compiler/bytecode equivalence claim.
trusted_components: Python wrapper, POSIX/macOS host and hardware

solver_settings.assisted: AI-authored exact Lean proofs, omega/nlinarith and explicit lemmas
